entry.title: New: RES24-216 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
URGING THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF THE NAVY AND THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE, INCLUDING THE DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY, TO IMMEDIATELY IMPLEMENT WEEKLY TESTING OF ALL NAVY RED HILL MONITORING WELLS AND DRINKING WATER WELLS FOR ALL CHEMICAL CONTAMINANTS STEMMING FROM PAST FUEL AND HAZARDOUS MATERIALS THAT WERE USED, STORED, OR RELEASED AT THE RED HILL BULK FUEL STORAGE FACILITY.

Latest action: Adopted.
